name: DaFang AI DF033 wall finishing robot
summary: Four-in-one wheeled wall finishing robot with swappable modules for grinding, putty skimming, sanding and spray painting, using visual self-driving and laser sensing. Smaller sibling of the DF062.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found. DaFang AI (Singapore, Hong Kong and a factory in Dongguan) takes enquiries at marketing@dafang.ai; its site shows customer reviews from Italy and Russia.

specs.label: Functions
specs.value: Grinding, skimming, sanding and painting (swappable modules)
specs.quote: combining functions of grinding, skimming, sanding and painting

specs.label: Modules
specs.quote: Wheeled wall robot with four swappable modules: grinding, putty skimming, sanding and spray painting

notes: Arm and reach are not described on the pages read.
Uses visual autonomous driving, laser sensing, automatic spraying and automatic vacuuming according to the maker.
